infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: mapper.one uses your location to show your position on the map and track your movement in the field.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: mapper.one keeps your off-route alerts firing while the app is in your pocket or your screen is locked during a route follow.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: mapper.one uses the camera so you can attach a photo to a waypoint along your route.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: mapper.one needs access to your photo library so you can attach existing photos to waypoints along your route.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: mapper.one saves waypoint photos to your Camera Roll so you always have a copy on your device.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: mapper.one can choose a trusted contact to receive your private live route link.
